bookrunners: Keefe, Bruyette & Woods, A Stifel Company
data.use_of_proceeds: The Company intends to use the net proceeds from this offering for general corporate purposes, including providing capital to FirstBank to support its growth.

tranches.pricing_quote: From and including October 1, 2031 to, but excluding, the Maturity Date, or the earlier redemption date (the "floating rate period"), the Notes will bear interest at a floating rate per year equal to the Benchmark rate (which is expected to be Three-Month Term SOFR) plus 205 basis points
